d47df7f2decc0cd93f27deb58cc21c3071c9fcb8.summary: A Natto Team Substack post, first published 2024-09-04 with a June 2026 note, on reconnaissance scanning tools used by Chinese threat actors and similar open-source tools. The note says 2026 reports describe China-nexus APT groups, including Volt Typhoon, industrialising reconnaissance. It cites a Black Lotus Labs report on June 10, 2026 about the JDY botnet. The text is truncated behind a paywall.

d4eeb21e1531c151f318541d048c1b980fa857a8.summary: Microsoft, as reported by The Record in January 2023, said nation-state groups from China, Iran, North Korea and Turkey were abusing the Log4Shell vulnerability to reach targeted networks. Named actors were PHOSPHORUS (Iran, deploying ransomware) and HAFNIUM (China, attacking virtualization infrastructure). Microsoft also saw initial access brokers selling footholds to ransomware gangs. Khonsari, a low-effort ransomware that tried to frame a person of Iranian descent, was spotted using the exploit. Over 60 exploit variants were observed, linked to DDoS botnets, crypto-mining and commodity…
